person.headline: Data Analyst — SQL (Oracle/PostgreSQL/SQL Server) · Tableau & Power BI · Python ETL · Geospatial transport analytics

location.note: Most recent role was based in León; candidate is resident in Seville and seeking remote or hybrid arrangements.

summary: Data Analyst with 2.5 years dedicated to data work in passenger transport and telecommunications, holding a BSc in Software Engineering (Universitat Oberta de Catalunya, July 2026, taught entirely in English, GPA 8.28/10). Covers the full cycle: extraction and modelling in Oracle, PostgreSQL and SQL Server; ETL and automation in Python; delivery in Tableau, Power BI and advanced Excel. Two distinguishing specialisations: geospatial transport analytics (QGIS, OSRM, GTFS, route-adherence analysis from geolocation) and data quality, drawn from ten prior years as a quality and audit technician under ISO 9001, 17020, 17025 and 22000. Builds pipelines with pre-load validation and input–output reconciliation rather than transformation alone.

compensation.note: 35,000 EUR is the minimum. The final salary depends on the overall package (remote/hybrid policy, benefits, and specific responsibilities).

experienceSummary.seniorityNote: Mid-level. Dedicated data experience is 2.5 years.

industryAffinity.note: Food industry, nutrition and agri-food are a genuine domain advantage — the candidate holds two master's degrees and ten years of professional experience in that field, which shortens ramp-up considerably for analytics on quality, traceability, shelf life, supply chain or food safety data. This is a preference and an asset, NOT a filter. The candidate is actively interested in data roles in any sector and should be matched against general Data Analyst, BI Analyst and Analytics Engineer requisitions on equal terms.

languages.note: Undergraduate degree in Software Engineering was delivered entirely in English.

notCurrentlyHeld.note: Declared explicitly so that matching agents do not infer these from adjacent skills. Accurate as of 2026-08.

experience.summary: Operational and geospatial analytics for service planning — routes, fleets, frequencies, calendars and network maps. Built the province-wide service-change ETL pipeline, automated route generation, and delivered Tableau dashboards to the Operations Directorate.

achievements.description: Designed and built the complete Python pipeline for service registrations and changes across an entire province: automated email intake, transformation into the corporate data model, database loading, and automatic input–output reconciliation to guarantee record integrity.
Automated route generation in QGIS from stop data and the OSRM routing API, replacing manual tracing.

Built route-adherence analytics comparing vehicle geolocation against published GTFS traces: broken-trip detection, percentage similarity to the reference route, unplanned diversions from roadworks, and delays. Selected the geodesic distance formula on the basis of accuracy at mid latitudes.
Built and maintained nine Tableau dashboards on connection nodes, delays, inter-stop distance, frequencies and routes, with automated publishing.
Produced analytical presentations in Marimo with live scraping and interactive controls, allowing the displayed KPI to be re-cut during the meeting according to the audience.
Integrated heterogeneous sources — Google Sheets, Excel files arriving by email, Oracle and PostgreSQL — with automated extraction in VBA and Python.

experience.summary: Real-time performance monitoring of three concurrent contact-centre campaigns, daily automated client reporting, and unit-economics analysis of lead acquisition.

achievements.description: Monitored three concurrent contact-centre campaigns in real time — Legálitas (legal services), Iberdrola (energy) and insurance — on the corporate omnichannel contact-centre platform.
Automated eight daily reports in Power BI and Excel summarising campaign performance, distributed directly to clients.
Defined and tracked operational and sales KPIs: contactability, abandon rate, conversion, average handling time, average time to sale.

Analysed lead profitability against acquisition price and attempt count, and compared fractional versus single-block purchasing of contact databases, producing a recommendation on purchasing strategy.
Administered and queried campaign databases in Microsoft SQL Server and Microsoft Access; automated recurring processes in Python.

projects.name: Public-sector job posting aggregator
projects.problem: Public-sector openings in Spain are published across many uncoordinated bulletins and portals with no common format, making systematic tracking impractical by hand.
projects.approach: Multi-source scraper covering BOE, BOJA, provincial bulletins, SAS and SAE, normalising heterogeneous postings into a single schema and tracking each opening's status over time.
projects.result: Continuous automated monitoring replacing manual review across five-plus sources.

projects.name: Question bank and study system for public examinations
projects.problem: Past-paper questions recur at uneven rates and are not mapped to syllabus sections, so study effort is allocated poorly.
projects.approach: Python application storing a bank of past examinations, computing recurrence frequency per question, mapping each question to its syllabus section, scheduling spaced repetition, and linking each question directly to the explanation of its answer.
projects.result: Study prioritisation driven by measured question frequency rather than intuition.

Validation at the point of load rather than correction downstream
Accuracy over speed in reported figures
